records.text: A song of the ascents. I lifted my eyes to the mountains. From where will my help come?
My help is from the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
Do not give your foot over to shaking, and may your Keeper not slumber.
Behold, the One guarding Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
The Lord will guard you; the Lord is your shelter at your right hand.
By day the sun will not scorch you, nor the moon by night.
The Lord will guard you from all evil; He will guard your soul.
The Lord will guard your coming in and your going out, from now and for ever.
Now his older son was in the field. As he came and drew near the house, he heard music and dancing.
And he called one of the servants and asked what these things might mean.
He said to him, ‘Your brother has come, and your father slaughtered the fattened calf because he received him back in good health.’
But he became angry and was unwilling to enter. His father came out and pleaded with him.
But he answered his father, ‘Behold, all these years I have served you as a slave, and I never disobeyed your command; yet you never gave me a young goat so that I might be glad with my friends.
But when this son of yours came, who devoured your livelihood with prostitutes, you slaughtered the fattened calf for him!’
And he said to him, ‘Child, you are always with me, and everything of mine is yours.
But we had to be glad and rejoice, because this brother of yours was dead and came to life; he was lost and was found.’”
The devil went out from the Lord and struck Job with a grievous ulcer from his feet to his head.
He took a potsherd to scrape off the discharge, and sat on the dung heap outside the city.
The children of Israel were mustered and came to meet them. Israel camped opposite them like two flocks of goats, while Syria filled the land.

The man of God approached and said to the king of Israel, “Thus says the Lord: ‘Because Syria has said, “The Lord, Israel’s God, is a God of mountains and not a God of valleys,” I will give this great force into your hand, and you will know that I am the Lord.’”
They camped opposite one another for seven days. On the seventh day battle began, and Israel struck down a hundred thousand Syrian foot soldiers in one day.

I did not choose this fast, or a day for a person to humble his life. Even if you bend your neck like a ring and spread sackcloth and ashes beneath you, you will not thereby call it an acceptable fast.

‘It is not such a fast that I chose,’ says the Lord. ‘Instead, loosen every bond of injustice, undo the strangling ties of coercive agreements, release the crushed, and tear up every unjust written contract.
Break your bread for the hungry and bring homeless poor people into your house. If you see someone naked, clothe him; do not overlook those belonging to your own family.
Daughter of My people, gird yourself with sackcloth; sprinkle yourself with ashes. Make mourning for yourself for a beloved one, a pitiful lament, because misery will suddenly come upon you.

When Mordecai learned what was being accomplished, he tore his clothes, put on sackcloth, and sprinkled himself with ashes. Rushing out through the city square, he cried with a loud voice, “A nation that has done no wrong is being swept away!”
He came as far as the king’s gate and stood there, for he was not permitted to enter the court wearing sackcloth and ashes.
In every territory where the letters were posted, there was shouting, lamentation, and great mourning among the Jews; they spread sackcloth and ashes for themselves.
I will enter Thy house with whole burnt offerings; I will pay Thee my vows,
which my lips declared and my mouth spoke in my affliction.
I will offer Thee marrow-rich whole burnt offerings, with incense and rams; I will prepare oxen with he-goats for Thee. Diapsalma.
